title: Modulation of Epigenetic Control by Advanced Molecular Tweezers.
authors: My-Hue-Le; Kamba, Bianca; Matena, Anja; Beuck, Christine; Momand, Victoria; Salvanos, Spiros; Vossen, Jessica; Blueggel, Mike; Schrader, Thomas; Bayer, Peter
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子镊超分子体系靶向组蛋白H4赖氨酸以干扰核小体-DNA互作，虽涉及蛋白-DNA体系但非TF-DNA，且方法为实验与MD模拟，AI缺失，属广义蛋白-DNA互作的可借鉴文献。
abstract: This work addresses the question if supramolecular systems can be tailored to interfere with posttranslational modifications (PTM) and epigenetics. As a prominent example, the efficient epigenetic control operative in nucleosome-DNA interactions was selected. Conceptually, transcription activation by specific acetylation of strategic lysine residues on the Histone H4 protein is replaced by noncovalent inclusion of the respective lysine residues inside the cavities of designed molecular tweezers. To this end, novel dimeric molecular tweezers with functional linkers were designed, which exhibit nanomolar affinity to the DNA-binding fragment of histone H4. Fluorescence titrations and ITC measurements provide experimental evidence for high selectivity over other lysine-containing H4 areas. Notably, rigid short linkers with hydrogen bond donors outperform flexible peptidic connections. MD simulations identified new binding motifs involving attractive interactions between H4 residues and linker functionalities. The ability of modified tweezers to interrupt the essential histone-DNA interaction was demonstrated in a fluorescence anisotropy assay. In addition, the most powerful tweezers with high H4 affinity were subjected to a competitive enzymatic HAT experiment, where they successfully competed for lysine binding sites and impaired HAT function. Thus, powerful new histone binders were developed which act as supramolecular PTM on a histone H4 peptide.
abstract_zh: 本工作探讨了超分子系统能否被设计用于干扰翻译后修饰（PTM）和表观遗传学的问题。作为一个突出示例，选择了核小体-DNA相互作用中高效的表观遗传调控机制。概念上，通过组蛋白H4蛋白上关键赖氨酸残基的特异性乙酰化实现的转录激活，被设计分子镊子空腔内相应赖氨酸残基的非共价包合所替代。为此，设计了具有功能性连接基的新型二聚体分子镊子，其对组蛋白H4的DNA结合片段表现出纳摩尔级亲和力。荧光滴定和ITC测量提供了实验证据，表明其对其他含赖氨酸的H4区域具有高选择性。值得注意的是，具有氢键供体的刚性短连接基优于柔性肽连接。分子动力学模拟识别出涉及H4残基与连接基功能团之间吸引相互作用的新结合基序。修饰后镊子中断必需组蛋白-DNA相互作用的能力在荧光各向异性实验中得到了验证。此外，对具有高H4亲和力的最强镊子进行了竞争性酶促HAT实验，其中它们成功竞争赖氨酸结合位点并损害了HAT功能。因此，开发了强效的新型组蛋白结合剂，其作为组蛋白H4肽上的超分子PTM发挥作用。
